findings.title: unsubscribe action lacks authentication/authorization guard
findings.body: The `unsubscribe` action calls `TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, ...)` without checking that `current_user` is present (there's no `ensure_logged_in` filter applied for anonymous email-link visits since this route is meant to be visited from an email link, often without session). If `current_user` is nil, `current_user.id` raises NoMethodError. Also no `guardian.ensure_can_see!` check is performed on the topic before mutating notification state, and `tu` may be nil if no TopicUser record exists yet (e.g., user never visited the topic), causing `tu.notification_level` to raise NoMethodError on nil.

findings.title: TopicUser record may not exist, causing crash
findings.body: `TopicUser.find_by` returns nil when the user has no TopicUser row for the topic (e.g. has never visited/posted). The subsequent `tu.notification_level` call will raise a NoMethodError instead of gracefully creating/updating via `TopicUser.change`, which is the pattern used elsewhere in the codebase (e.g., `set_notifications` action uses `TopicUser.change`).

findings.title: mailing_list_notify omits unsubscribe_url
findings.body: `send_notification_email` now relies on `post.topic.unsubscribe_url` being referenced via `email_opts[:unsubscribe_url]`, which is fine since it's inside `send_notification_email`. However, the `add_unsubscribe_link: true` passed from `mailing_list_notify` and other callers always triggers template substitution of `%{unsubscribe_url}` in `unsubscribe_link` locale string; if `unsubscribe_url` isn't present in template_args (e.g., for `digest` mailer, which still sets `add_unsubscribe_link: true` but does NOT set `unsubscribe_url`), the `%{unsubscribe_url}` placeholder in the i18n string will be left unresolved or raise a missing interpolation argument error, since `I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args)` requires the key but `digest` mailer never supplies `unsubscribe_url`.

findings.title: unsubscribe_link requires unsubscribe_url interpolation but not all callers supply it
findings.body: The `unsubscribe_link` translation now requires `%{unsubscribe_url}`, but it's used by `digest` (via `build_email`) and other mailers that set `add_unsubscribe_link: true` without passing `unsubscribe_url` in opts/template_args. This will raise `I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument` for those emails (e.g., digest emails), breaking all digest email delivery.

findings.title: render :show explicitly added but may conflict with implicit render for unsubscribe action
findings.body: `perform_show_response`'s html format block now explicitly calls `render :show`, but this method is shared by `unsubscribe` action, which presumably wants its own `show` template context (fine) but no distinct unsubscribe view/template was added for non-JS (non-Ember) rendering; the front-end relies on a new `topic/unsubscribe` Ember route/template, but the server-rendered `show.html.erb` for GET requests to `/t/.../unsubscribe` will render as if it were a normal topic page, not an unsubscribe-specific page, potentially confusing users who load the link without JS enabled.
